title: What data do world models learn from?
summary: Perceptual data plus action-labelled records of what happened after an action.
body: Modern world models may learn from perceptual and interaction data such as images, video, audio, sensor recordings and action-outcome trajectories. Action-labelled interaction data is especially scarce because it cannot simply be scraped from the web at the scale of text and images.
